description: Key financial metrics normalized from SEC XBRL companyfacts, one row per FISCAL period (fy/fp are the company's fiscal year and quarter, e.g. Microsoft FY2024 = 2023-07-01..2024-06-30; fiscal_year_end gives the MM-DD; deduped; as-filed values from the filing that reported the period). Metrics: revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt, shares_outstanding, free_cash_flow (derived); aliases accepted in metrics: revenues→revenue, sales→revenue, net_sales→revenue, total_revenue→revenue, turnover→revenue, net_profit→net_income, profit→net_income, earnings→net_income, net_earnings→net_income, eps→eps_diluted, diluted_eps→eps_diluted, basic_eps→eps_basic, operating_profit→operating_income, cfo→operating_cash_flow, cash_from_operations→operating_cash_flow, capital_expenditures→capex, fcf→free_cash_flow, assets→total_assets, liabilities→total_liabilities, equity→stockholders_equity, shareholders_equity→stockholders_equity, cash_and_equivalents→cash, debt→long_term_debt, shares→shares_outstanding. Each metric tries common tags in order (revenue: Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueNet, ...) and tags_used reports which was used. period_type 'quarterly' returns 3-month values (cash-flow quarters derived from YTD; Q4 derived as FY minus 9M). If a company has only 10-Q data (e.g. a recent IPO), annual results are empty and hint says to use 'quarterly'. Values are raw (e.g. 391035000000 = $391.0B).

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

metrics.description: Subset of metrics to return (default all); aliases such as sales, eps, fcf, equity are accepted

name: get_financials
title: Normalized financials (XBRL)
